episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Fresh off another unsuccessful date, Joanne sashays into a friend's party and meets Noah, an adorable rabbi who recently broke up with his girlfriend.

episodes.title: A Shiksa Walks Into a Temple
episodes.summary: Joanne and Noah get to know each other, but reality hits when she learns about his romantic history and he deals with an interrogation from his family.

episodes.title: Either Aura
episodes.summary: A podcast pile-on about her aura and an unanswered text make Joanne question if she's a good match for Noah, who faces a guilt trip after an accident.

episodes.title: Obliterated
episodes.summary: Joanne's last-minute dash to pick up a sex toy for a podcast episode makes for a memorable first date with Noah. Sasha helps Miriam with a boy problem.

episodes.title: My Friend Joanne
episodes.summary: Work obligations interfere with Noah and Joanne's plans to take their relationship to the next level, while Sasha and Morgan bond over family dynamics.

episodes.title: The Ick
episodes.summary: During an impromptu get-together with Joanne's family, Noah is determined to make a good impression — so determined that it's a major turnoff.

episodes.title: WAGS
episodes.summary: Meeting Joanne's friends? Easy enough for Noah. But winning over his pals means making nice with their wives and girlfriends, who are close to his ex.

episodes.title: Rebecca's Box
episodes.summary: Joanne's discovery of a small box in Noah's bedroom turns into something much bigger as she fights the urge to snoop, and he receives big news at work.

episodes.title: My Girl Bina
episodes.summary: Power games and a custom-made charcuterie board complicate Joanne's official introduction to Noah's parents. Morgan asks Sasha for a favor.

episodes.title: Bat Mitzvah Crashers
episodes.summary: Miriam's Big Apple-themed bat mitzvah sets the scene for even greater life changes when Noah and Joanne confront questions about their future.

episodes.title: Dinner Party
episodes.summary: Riding high on romance, Joanne and Noah merge their friend groups at a dinner party. But an offhand comment reveals they're not quite on the same page.

episodes.title: Leave It at the Tree
episodes.summary: When Joanne nudges Noah to express his feelings, he surprises even himself. Morgan's request for constructive feedback quickly devolves into blowback.

episodes.title: The Unethical Therapist
episodes.summary: An unlikely guest stirs things up on the podcast. Morgan's polarizing plus-one raises eyebrows at a party. Bina gets pushy with Sasha and Esther.

episodes.title: Valentine's Day
episodes.summary: When Noah cooks up a swoon-worthy Valentine's plan, Joanne worries about his true intentions — and the price of setting aside her own traditions.

episodes.title: Abby Loves Smoothies
episodes.summary: Intending to support Noah at a baby-naming ceremony, Joanne can't resist teaming up with Morgan for some payback against a former rival.

episodes.title: Anything Can Happen
episodes.summary: Still reeling from Noah's request for a "night off" from her, Joanne tries to keep it together as her parents meet his for the first time.

episodes.title: When You Know, You Know
episodes.summary: A blunder on an important shopping trip sets off fireworks on the podcast. Noah's modern new workplace delivers some old-fashioned culture shock.

episodes.title: A Better Rabbi
episodes.summary: Noah guides a surprisingly experienced new student. Joanne faces mounting pressure. Morgan recruits Sasha to dig up some digital dirt.

episodes.title: Crossroads
episodes.summary: An afternoon couples' hang goes off the rails when a provocative party game reveals everyone's most uncomfortable truths.

episodes.title: When Noah Met Joanne
episodes.summary: The complexities of love get all too real at a lavish celebration, as Joanne and Noah question what's worth holding onto — and what's slipping away.
